verdict.rationale: The Virginia State Corporation Commission is a government regulatory and filing authority, not a software product a buyer could deploy, so self-hosting the core product is a category error for this kind of service. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes showing the sites disallow crawling; none of it suggests the Commission ships self-hostable software that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
